answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, slashed on a failed audit. The horizon holds work receipts rather than names, so the lantern of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the spiral is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
